text.en: Clients express immense gratitude toward the trainers and boarding staff for their dedication and professionalism. Reviewers frequently mention trainers such as Ricky and Laurie by name, praising their patient teaching methods and clear guidance. Handlers are commended for creating a supportive environment for boarding pets.

Owners of both puppies and adult dogs report significant behavioural improvements following board-and-train and group classes. Reviewers note dramatic reductions in leash pulling, improved impulse control, and reliable response to commands. Multiple clients observe that structured training exercises translated smoothly to home life.

Reviews highlight the team's thoughtful handling of pets with unique requirements, including elderly dogs with mobility issues and timid cats. Pet parents appreciate that staff members adjust daily routines to accommodate physical limitations like hip dysplasia. Animals return from boarding and daycare relaxed and contented.

q.en: Does Fon Jon board cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, the facility offers cat condos with attached catios in a quiet area, and clients note that staff accommodate individual feeding and fountain preferences.

q.en: What training formats are available for dogs?

a.en: Pet parents report participating in private lessons, group obedience classes, and multi-week board-and-train programmes with home follow-ups.

q.en: Can the facility accommodate pets with joint or health limitations?

a.en: Reviewers note that trainers and boarding attendants carefully tailor activities for pets with physical conditions such as hip dysplasia.

q.en: Are grooming and bath services available on site?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently add bath and grooming appointments to boarding stays so dogs return clean and fresh.
